'''Chris Kuebler''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Dagobah Regionals]] on 29 July 2000 with [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|RallOps]], according to James Barrett's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1076">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-02-dagobah-regionals-29-july-00d1076/ dagobah-regionals-29-july-00], DeckTech (James "jamesandkris" Barrett, 2 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-02-dagobah-regionals-29-july-00d1076/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
